tests.is_a_review: title, the abstract's first words ('This is a protocol for a Cochrane Review') and PubMed publication type: protocols, evidence and gap maps, scoping or mapping reviews, withdrawn reviews, corrections, editorials and retractions are not reviews with a conclusion
tests.published_in_window: PubMed electronic publication date (ArticleDate), else the issue date, within 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-30
tests.states_a_certainty_grade: the PubMed abstract contains a GRADE certainty or quality term ('low-certainty', 'moderate quality', 'certainty of the evidence', 'GRADE', 'strength of evidence')
tests.public_abstract: PubMed holds an abstract (PubMed abstracts are public)
tests.not_a_whu_topic: the title matches none of the excluded-topic patterns (EXCLUDED_TOPICS)
